steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 9x13-inch pan with floured cooking spray.
In a large bowl, mix cake mix, margarine, 1 egg, and 2 teaspoons vanilla together. Press into the prepared pan as a crust.
In the same bowl, beat cream cheese, 2 eggs, and 2 teaspoons vanilla until combined. Gradually mix in confectioners' sugar until smooth. Pour over crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until cake rises up around the sides of the pan and looks sunken in the middle, 35 to 40 minutes. Allow to cool before cutting into 24 bars.

raw_recipe.headline: Chewy Butter Cake
raw_recipe.description: Try this chewy butter cake recipe for a delicious treat that's simple to make. You'll love the cake-like crust covered with sweetened cream cheese.

review.reviewBody: This was pretty good although it was more like a brownie than cake. Be sure to let this cool COMPLETELY before cutting or it appears to be gooey. Otherwise, it's great!!! Enjoy!

Way too SWEET!!!!!!!!!!!! But the next time I changed the proportion of ingredients and it was really good. Here is my revised recipe:
1 package yellow cake mix. I use 
Duncan Hines Butter recipe. 1/2 cup butter,melted. 4 eggs. 8 oz cream cheese, softened. 3/4 cup powdered sugar. And this is not a mistake; only 3/4 cup. 1 tsp each vanilla and lemon flavoring. In a large mixing bowl, combine yellow cake mix, melted margarine, and 2 beaten eggs. Pour into a greased and floured 13"x9" cake pan. Please note that the cake mix mixture will have the consistency of a dough more so than a cake, so it will be kind of thick. You can use a spatula to spread it. In a blender or food processor, combine softened cream cheese, powdered sugar, 2 beaten eggs; vanilla/lemon .... flavorings (to taste). Pour over the cake mixture. Bake 40 to 45 minutes, or until golden. 
You can use a 13X9 pyrex or 2 squared foil pans (about 8x8) . You can also cut into small squares and serve.

This is sooo good. I cut the sugar from 4 cups to 2-1/2 cups as suggested in reviews. Also added 1 extra egg in the cream cheese mixture for a total of 4 eggs. It set up perfectly. Was chewy goodness. Family loved. I also added pecans. Served with ice cream. I will definitely make this again.

This recipe is easy. I thought it was going sweet to be killer and it was not...I used a 825 g box of cake mix and it worked. I think i would add vanilla,orange, lemon or even coffee flavor into it. As a Chef and Catered it was quick but not very nice to look at. I expected it to be more chewy or buttery. I would not serve it at a catering event but to my family...yes. Just wanted to try it and I would make it again>>>NOTE this taste better the next day and it cuts better with an oiled knife! I also used 4 eggs instead of 3...works better
We werent crazy about it ... maybe I did something wrong. It was ok, just not great. I think I would enjoy it more with a chocolate mix.. or maybe lemon??

This is an amazingly versatile recipe, and a big hit whenever I bring it into work. Experiment using different flavors of cake mix such as chocolate sprinkled with mini M&M's (DECADENT!) lemon, or even strawberry as I tried today. You'll love it!
I made this for my husband at work. He said everyone loved it. I substituted chocolate cake for yellow and added milk chocolate chips.
No changes. It is really moist and chewy! Very good!
I would cut back the amount of sugar in the cream cheese mix next time. Otherwise, everyone loved the combination.

I have been using this recipe for a long time. I can't remember where I first got it, but here it is. It is so good and everyone always loves it and asks for the recipe. It is VERY sweet so I only make it for company or if taking somewhere. Also, I cut into small squares, instead of bars since it is so sweet. FYI, this will not have the consistency of normal cake. It will be gooey inside and crusted top.

The kids loved this bar...not to mention they were bouncing off the walls on a sugar high for the rest of the day. I am curious, is the cream cheese layer suppose to be runny or set up more like a cheesecake consistency? Mine was runny and I'm wondering if I needed to bake it longer. The taste sure makes it worth trying again.
My husband LOVED this! It's very good. It's fun to try different flavor combinations with this one!
This recipe is so easy to make and an excellent desert to bring to a potluck or social gathering. Very yummy, forget about dieting!
OH THIS ONE IS IT, THE TASTE IS OUTSTANDING, VERY RICH BUT VERY GOOD, TYR IT YOU WILL LOVE IT GLENDA~TEXAS

Did I do something wrong? The cake was tasty,but
the top had a crisp crust, and the center was
too gooey. It had the consistency of uncooked cake batter. Yuck! I made it exactly as instructed, and baked it for the appropriate time.
I had to throw it away!
